sentences.zh: 所以在剧本里，这场戏并不是在我们陷害托比的那一天发生的。

sentences.en: It was the next day.
sentences.zh: 那是第二天。

sentences.en: But in editing, they moved it up, and we are going to end instead with a delicious Dwight talking head.
sentences.zh: 但在剪辑时，他们把它提前了，而我们最后会以一段精彩的德怀特独白收尾。

sentences.en: We'll get to it.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿会讲到。

sentences.en: But first, Jim needs to show Pam what he's done.
sentences.zh: 但首先，吉姆得向帕姆展示他的成果。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Jim is nervous but excited.
sentences.zh: 吉姆很紧张，但也很兴奋。

sentences.en: He is, as my daughter says, nervous-sided.
sentences.zh: 他就像我女儿说的那样，处于“紧张状态”。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And she's like, why are we stopping at your parents' house?
sentences.zh: 然后她问，为什么我们要停在你父母家？

sentences.en: And he says, I bought it.
sentences.zh: 他说，我把它买下来了。

sentences.en: And then Jenna, at 18 minutes, two seconds, Jim says, let's go inside.
sentences.zh: 然后珍娜，在18分02秒时，吉姆说，我们进去吧。

sentences.en: I'll show you inside.
sentences.zh: 我带你看看里面。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Has Pam never been inside the house?
sentences.zh: 帕姆从来没进过这房子吗？

sentences.en: We got so much mail about that.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了好多关于这点的来信。

sentences.en: People wrote in.
sentences.zh: 人们写信来问。

sentences.en: They said, if Pam knew they were at Jim's parents' house when they pulled up, wouldn't that mean she's been there before and she's probably been inside?
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果帕姆在车停下时就知道那是吉姆父母家，那不就意味着她以前去过，而且很可能进去过吗？

sentences.en: You would hope Pam has been inside his parents' house.
sentences.zh: 你当然希望帕姆进过他父母的房子。

sentences.en: They've been dating for a while.
sentences.zh: 他们已经交往一段时间了。

sentences.en: They live in the same town.
sentences.zh: 他们住在同一个镇上。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's interesting because his parents have moved out, but they've left some furniture.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这很有趣，因为他父母已经搬走了，但留下了一些家具。

sentences.en: Also, how rough were they on this house?
sentences.zh: 还有，他们把这房子折腾得有多破啊？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And Jim says, I was helping my mom out.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，我是在帮我妈忙。

sentences.en: Where's his dad?
sentences.zh: 他爸呢？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I have a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我有一堆疑问。

sentences.en: There were a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 有很多问题。

sentences.en: Rachel M.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋·M.

sentences.en: and Megan L.
sentences.zh: 和梅根·L.

sentences.en: said, question for Jenna.
sentences.zh: 提问给珍娜。

sentences.en: In this episode, when Jim is showing Pam his parents' house, I was wondering what went into how you decided to play this scene?
sentences.zh: 在这一集中，当吉姆带帕姆看他父母的房子时，我想知道你是如何决定如何演绎这一幕的？

sentences.en: Because she seems really worried and unexcited, but then in the end, she says she loves it.
sentences.zh: 因为她看起来真的很担心，也很不兴奋，但最后她却说她很喜欢。

sentences.en: Any input you could give about how you decided to play this or what the director told you would be super appreciated.
sentences.zh: 如果你能分享一下你是如何决定表演方式的，或者导演对你说了什么，我们将不胜感激。

sentences.en: Well, guys, we've already discussed my personal opinions on someone buying someone else a house without telling them.
sentences.zh: 好吧，伙计们，关于有人在不告知对方的情况下买房这件事，我已经表达过我的个人看法了。

sentences.en: So this was a little bit of a mental gymnastics for me to get Pam to the place where she's going to say she loves it and where she says that line.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，要让帕姆达到那种会说“我喜欢”并说出那句台词的状态，确实需要一点心理建设。

sentences.en: I mean, you bought me a house because it was like not how I would react as Jenna.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你给我买了一套房子，因为这和我作为珍娜本人的反应完全不同。

sentences.en: You know, I had to really play the character and play the character's truth.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我必须真正进入角色，并演绎出角色的真实感受。

sentences.en: And in the script, I was being told that my character's truth was that she loved this gesture and it made her feel loved.
sentences.zh: 剧本里告诉我，我角色的真实感受是她喜欢这个举动，这让她感到被爱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I think we often did that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我觉得我们经常这样做。

sentences.en: Obviously, we had to play the truth for the character.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们必须演绎出角色的真实感受。

sentences.en: I mean, I hope you guys know I'm not very much like Angela Martin and how I would react to things.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我希望你们知道，我和安吉拉·马丁在面对事情时的反应不太一样。

sentences.en: But it made sense to me, Jenna, for Pam, you know, and Jim made the garage into this art studio and he's really putting down some roots with her.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，珍娜，对于帕姆来说，这说得通。吉姆把车库改成了艺术工作室，他真的在和她一起扎根。

sentences.en: And I think Pam wanted a family and she wanted all of these things that Jim is offering her.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为帕姆想要一个家庭，她想要吉姆提供给她的所有这些东西。

sentences.en: She had wanted that.
sentences.zh: 她一直渴望这些。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I had thought a little bit back on The Talking Head where Pam discusses what her perfect home would look like, how she always wanted a home with a terrace.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，我回想了一下帕姆讨论她理想家园是什么样子的那个访谈片段，她一直想要一个带露台的家。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You know, picking her home seemed like something that Pam was attached to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，挑选自己的家似乎是帕姆很看重的事情。

sentences.en: So I did bring that up.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实提到了这一点。

sentences.en: I said, you know, we've established that Pam has daydreamed about what her home would look like.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，我们已经设定了帕姆曾幻想过她的家会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And now this person has taken her out of the process.
sentences.zh: 而现在这个人把她排除在了这个过程之外。

sentences.en: You brought that up to the writers at the time of when we were filming?
sentences.zh: 你在拍摄的时候向编剧提过这件事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so I was saying, like, help me understand why Pam now is so happy and so excited.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在说，帮我理解为什么帕姆现在这么开心、这么兴奋。

sentences.en: And, Angela, we got to exactly what you just said, which was that it was a vulnerable thing for Pam to give up the art school track.
sentences.zh: 而且，安吉拉，我们得出了你刚才说的结论，那就是帕姆放弃艺术学校的道路是一件很脆弱的事情。

sentences.en: And she did that because of two reasons.
sentences.zh: 她这样做有两个原因。

sentences.en: One, graphic design wasn't what she meant she wanted to do as an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 第一，平面设计并不是她作为艺术家真正想做的事情。

sentences.en: And two, she's ready.
sentences.zh: 第二，她准备好了。

sentences.en: She's very, very ready to start living this married life, to be in the season of family and marriage with this man that she's been waiting years for.
sentences.zh: 她非常、非常准备好开始这种婚姻生活了，准备好与这个她等待了多年的男人进入家庭和婚姻的阶段。

sentences.en: And so this home is her fast track to that season of her life.
sentences.zh: 所以这个家是她进入人生那个阶段的快车道。

sentences.en: And she's just ready.
sentences.zh: 她已经准备好了。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're going to get to fix it up together.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们可以一起装修它。

sentences.en: So there's still that element of nesting that's going to get to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以仍然会有那种筑巢的元素发生。

sentences.en: And so that's kind of what I was thinking was like, I'm ready.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想的就是，我已经准备好了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you have to think, when Pam talked about her dream house with this tower and the terrace and all of that, she was in an unhappy relationship.
sentences.zh: 而且你得想想，当帕姆谈论她那带塔楼和露台的梦想家园时，她当时处于一段不幸福的关系中。

sentences.en: When you're in a place you feel stuck in life or you're unhappy, you daydream.
sentences.zh: 当你处于生活中感到受困或不快乐的状态时，你会做白日梦。

sentences.en: And you daydream about these fantastical things and their coping mechanisMs.
sentences.zh: 你会幻想那些虚幻的东西，那是你的应对机制。

sentences.en: And then when you're with someone you really love, you don't need the fantasy anymore.
sentences.zh: 而当你和真正爱的人在一起时，你就不再需要那种幻想了。

sentences.en: That's such a good point, Angela.
sentences.zh: 说得太好了，安吉拉。

sentences.en: You're just ready to have a life.
sentences.zh: 你只是准备好过生活了。

sentences.en: And she's ready to have that life.
sentences.zh: 而她已经准备好过那种生活了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, we did get some mail about that garage.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们确实收到了一些关于那个车库的来信。

sentences.en: Katie C.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·C.

sentences.en: and Chris G.
sentences.zh: 和克里斯·G.

sentences.en: said,
sentences.zh: 说道，

sentences.en: When Jim is showing Pam his parents' house, he says the garage has great lighting.
sentences.zh: 当吉姆带帕姆参观他父母家时，他说车库采光很好。

sentences.en: He then proceeds to open a windowless garage door, revealing a completely windowless garage space.
sentences.zh: 接着他打开了一扇没有窗户的车库门，露出了一个完全没有窗户的车库空间。

sentences.en: Where's the great lighting, Jim?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，采光好的地方在哪儿呢？

sentences.en: Where?
sentences.zh: 在哪儿？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, I thought that was really funny.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得那真的很好笑。

sentences.en: That is really funny.
sentences.zh: 那确实很好笑。

sentences.en: I want you guys to know that I have a garage that we use as a home office.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们知道，我有一个车库，我们把它当作家庭办公室用。

sentences.en: And for a long time, we would just raise the door.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，我们只是把门拉上去。

sentences.en: And then there would be amazing light, you know?
sentences.zh: 然后就会有很棒的光线，你懂的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So it did get great light, but you had to raise the door.
sentences.zh: 所以它确实采光很好，但你得把门拉上去才行。

sentences.en: And then years later, we actually just removed the door because we're like,
sentences.zh: 后来过了几年，我们干脆把门拆了，因为我们觉得，

sentences.en: this is never going to be a garage again.
sentences.zh: 这永远也不会再是车库了。

sentences.en: You know, we've sort of made it into this little home office and put an actual sliding glass door.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们把它改造成了一个小小的家庭办公室，还装了一扇真正的推拉玻璃门。

sentences.en: But I get it.
sentences.zh: 但我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: You just have to open it up.
sentences.zh: 你只需要把它打开就行了。

sentences.en: But he does present it like this garage has great lighting,
sentences.zh: 但他表现得好像这个车库采光特别好一样，

sentences.en: as if the other garages that you open, the whole side of the building, wouldn't have great lighting.
sentences.zh: 就好像其他车库只要把整面墙打开，采光就不会好似的。

sentences.en: He's presenting as if it's like a special feature that kind of applies to every garage
sentences.zh: 他表现得好像这是一种特殊功能，适用于每一个车库，

sentences.en: that doesn't have like a giant tree planted in front of it, which it wouldn't because it's a garage.
sentences.zh: 只要前面没种棵大树挡着——当然也不会有，因为那是车库。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Most garages are just boxes with no windows.
sentences.zh: 大多数车库都只是没有窗户的盒子。

sentences.en: I have to tell you two things about shooting these scenes at the house.
sentences.zh: 关于在房子里拍摄这些场景，我有两件事要告诉你们。

sentences.en: The scene where Jim is trying to take the clown painting off the wall for Pam is one of the hardest I've ever laughed on the show.
sentences.zh: 吉姆试图帮帕姆把墙上的小丑画取下来的那场戏，是我在剧组里笑得最厉害的场景之一。

sentences.en: It is the second hardest time.
sentences.zh: 那是第二好笑的时刻。

sentences.en: The first was when we did the scene in Dinner Party where Michael's showing us the tiny TV on the wall.
sentences.zh: 第一好笑的是我们在拍《晚宴》那集时，迈克尔向我们展示墙上那个微型电视的场景。

sentences.en: This is the second.
sentences.zh: 这是第二。

sentences.en: Every time John tried to lift the painting on the wall, I could not stop laughing.
sentences.zh: 每次约翰试图把墙上的画取下来时，我都笑得停不下来。

sentences.en: I don't know what it was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: Tears, tears, choking on our laughter.
sentences.zh: 眼泪，全是眼泪，我们笑得都快窒息了。

sentences.en: We laughed so hard.
sentences.zh: 我们笑得太厉害了。

sentences.en: I looked for it in the bloopers and it's not there.
sentences.zh: 我在花絮里找过，但没找到。

sentences.en: And I'm so upset it's not there.
sentences.zh: 没能收录进去让我很难过。

sentences.en: It took us like an hour to shoot that tiny moment of him trying to take the painting off the wall.
sentences.zh: 为了拍他试图把画从墙上取下来那个小片段，我们花了一个小时左右。

sentences.en: John is also so funny at physical comedy.
sentences.zh: 约翰在肢体喜剧方面也很有天赋。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I laughed out loud when he peeled back that fake wood paneling and it kind of startled him.
sentences.zh: 当他揭开那层假木板，被吓了一跳的时候，我笑出了声。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So then at the end of the scene in the garage, when we're hugging, I improvised the line,
sentences.zh: 所以后来在车库那场戏结束时，我们拥抱的时候，我即兴加了一句台词，

sentences.en: what about the clown?
sentences.zh: 那小丑怎么办？

sentences.en: And it made John laugh.
sentences.zh: 这把约翰逗笑了。

sentences.en: And that's why he's like burying his head into my neck.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他把头埋在我的脖子里。

sentences.en: And then when he said, yeah, I can't do anything about that, it made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 然后当他说“是啊，我对此无能为力”时，我也笑场了。

sentences.en: And so I'm like smushing my face into his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 所以我把脸埋进了他的肩膀里。

sentences.en: You can totally tell we're breaking.
sentences.zh: 你们完全看得出来我们笑场了。

sentences.en: And that's why it was because we were still, anytime we brought up the clown painting, we lost it.
sentences.zh: 原因就是我们当时只要一提到那幅小丑画，就彻底破功了。

sentences.en: I love that moment.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那个瞬间。

sentences.en: It made it intimate and funny and sweet.
sentences.zh: 它既亲密又好笑，还很甜蜜。

sentences.en: I think it's time to talk about the greatest Dwight talking head of all time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是时候聊聊德怀特有史以来最棒的单人访谈了。

sentences.en: That's saying a lot because there are some amazing Dwight talking heads, but this one really is like top five.
sentences.zh: 这评价很高，因为德怀特的精彩访谈有很多，但这一段绝对能排进前五。

sentences.en: He's going to describe his perfect crime.
sentences.zh: 他要描述他心目中的完美犯罪。

sentences.en: And I think we have to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们必须听听看。

sentences.en: What is my perfect crime?
sentences.zh: 什么是我的完美犯罪？

sentences.en: I break into Tiffany's in midnight.
sentences.zh: 我在午夜潜入蒂芙尼珠宝店。

sentences.en: Do I go for the vault?
sentences.zh: 我会去保险库吗？

sentences.en: No, I go for the chandelier.
sentences.zh: 不，我会去拿那个吊灯。

sentences.en: It's priceless.
sentences.zh: 它是无价之宝。

sentences.en: As I'm taking it down, a woman catches me.
sentences.zh: 当我把它取下来时，一个女人抓住了我。

sentences.en: She tells me to stop.
sentences.zh: 她叫我住手。

sentences.en: It's her father's business.
sentences.zh: 那是她父亲的生意。

sentences.en: She's Tiffany.
sentences.zh: 她就是蒂芙尼本人。

sentences.en: I say, no, we make love all night.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我们整晚都在缠绵。

sentences.en: In the morning, the cops come and I escape in one of their uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 早上警察来了，我穿上他们的制服逃走了。

sentences.en: I tell her to meet me in Mexico, but I go to Canada.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她去墨西哥见我，但我去了加拿大。

sentences.en: I don't trust her.
sentences.zh: 我不信任她。

sentences.en: Besides, I like the cold.
sentences.zh: 再说，我喜欢寒冷。

sentences.en: Thirty years later, I get a postcard.
sentences.zh: 三十年后，我收到了一张明信片。

sentences.en: I have a son, and he's the chief of police.
sentences.zh: 我有个儿子，他现在是警察局长。

sentences.en: This is where the story gets interesting.
sentences.zh: 故事到这里才变得有趣起来。

sentences.en: I tell Tiffany to meet me in Paris by the Trocadero.
sentences.zh: 我告诉蒂芙尼在巴黎的特罗卡德罗广场见我。

sentences.en: She's been waiting for me all these years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来她一直都在等我。

sentences.en: She's never taken another lover.
sentences.zh: 她从未找过其他情人。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: I don't show up.
sentences.zh: 我没去赴约。

sentences.en: I go to Berlin.
sentences.zh: 我去了柏林。

sentences.en: That's where I stash the chandelier.
sentences.zh: 那是我藏吊灯的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do not know how Rain got through saying, this is where the story gets interesting.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我真不知道雷恩是怎么忍住不笑说出“故事到这里才变得有趣起来”这句台词的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: Every time I watch this episode, I laughed at that line, and I watched it like three times.
sentences.zh: 每次看这一集，我都会被那句台词逗笑，我大概看了有三遍吧。

sentences.en: This entire talking head was scripted, and it was delivered as scripted.
sentences.zh: 这段单人访谈完全是照着剧本演的，而且演得和剧本一模一样。

sentences.en: I think this is one of the most brilliantly written pieces ever.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是有史以来写得最精彩的片段之一。

sentences.en: It's just so good.
sentences.zh: 真的太棒了。

sentences.en: It's so good, and who better to deliver it than Rainn Wilson as Dwight?
sentences.zh: 太棒了，而且由雷恩·威尔森饰演的德怀特来演绎，再合适不过了。

sentences.en: It was just perfect.
sentences.zh: 简直完美。
